claims.thesis: uint128 truncation in DynamicHelper._getTokensOwed when feeGrowthInside delta * liquidity / Q128 exceeds uint128.max
computeRatioX96 overflow returns 0 allowing zero-price bypass in downstream consumers
Round-trip swap profit via rounding direction mismatch between input and output fee calculations
Pool type returns amountOut > actual tokens moved, Core credits user excess
claims.reason: _safeDecrementUint128 underflow check at AMMModule.sol:3520 catches amountOut > reserve. Core also validates balance before/after at line 2208.

claims.thesis: Transfer handler called with mismatched token pair steals from settlement
claims.reason: ammHandleTransfer requires msg.sender==AMM (line 230 CLOBTransferHandler, line 115 PermitTransferHandler). Balance check at AMMModule:2208 catches under-delivery.

claims.thesis: Reentrancy through wrapped native deposit/refund corrupts swap state
claims.reason: Balance-before/after check at AMMModule:2208 validates exact amount transferred. The _depositWrappedNativeAndRefundExcess refund callback cannot manipulate the AMM's balance because WETH deposit is atomic and the excess refund goes to executor.

claims.thesis: Malicious pool type returns inflated amountOut to drain pool reserves
claims.evidence: Pool type address must have 6 leading zero bytes (AMMModule.sol:109). _safeDecrementUint128 reverts if amountOut > reserve (AMMModule.sol:1437). Balance check at AMMModule.sol:2208 verifies actual ERC20 transfer.

claims.thesis: Malicious transfer handler skips token transfer but core believes funds arrived
claims.evidence: Core checks balanceInBefore + swapCache.amountIn != balanceInAfter at AMMModule.sol:2208. Non-transferring handler caught by balance verification.

claims.thesis: Bypass pricing bounds via computeRatioX96 overflow in validateHandlerOrder
claims.evidence: computeRatioX96 returns 0 on overflow (SqrtPriceCalculator.sol:51-53). validateHandlerOrder missing zero check vs _validatePricingBounds which has it (line 847). But CLOB fills go through AMM swap path which has the check. Low severity only (CP-003). Confirmed via Halmos symbolic execution.

claims.thesis: Storage slot collision across diamond facets corrupts pool accounting
claims.evidence: Slither storage layout confirms all 4 modules have 0 local slots. All state via LBAMMStorage.appStorage() at slot 0x9A1D. No collision possible.

claims.thesis: Forged hook caller triggers hook logic with fake parameters to extract value
claims.evidence: All state-changing hooks check _requireCallerIsAMM() (lines 110, 159, 253, 320, 366, 386). validateHandlerOrder is view-only. Confirmed via Medusa fuzzing (10000 sequences, 0 failures).
